result: Math oracle: Karatsuba square root on the bits the rounding needs, Karatsuba products; same results, oracle sweep shard instructions -74% (f128) / -69% (x87), five sweeps' pass-1 test-seconds 21761 -> 9549

rulings.item: ln 10 by series (3 ln 2 + 2 atanh(1/9)) changes the cached constant beyond its error bound in the last bits, so part(2p+40) values (not correctly rounded results) can differ
rulings.recommendation: allow it in a follow-up story; correctly rounded results are unaffected, measure the shard share first

informational: complex_products pass-1 wall time 273 -> 390 s on a shared slot (the profile story saw 479 -> 217 with no oracle change); its double-precision oracle is not covered by the replay harness and was not counted deterministically: count one shard on base and head

ln 10 (brief item 3) NOT done: the precision a process needs is set per input by Ziv (not known up front) and the cache already grows geometrically; after this change consts::compute_ln10 is still 11.8% (f128) / 8.7% (x87) of shard 0 inclusive. A cheaper ln 10 (3 ln 2 + 2 atanh(1/9) by series; ln 2 is already cached) is unmeasured and can change the cached constant in its last bits (the #6890 history question): separate story
